verdict.rationale: Sai is Simular's core product: users describe work in plain English and the agent carries it out on a cloud computer or their own device across desktop apps, browsers, files and terminals. It asks for approval before sensitive steps, keeps working after the laptop is closed, reports via iMessage/Telegram, and lets users watch it work. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of delegation quality and reliability (all evidence is vendor-claimed).
